c2-job-0016: Job opens a search for wisdom by naming what is found in the earth. Read Job 28:1.
c2-job-0017: Job says God understands its way. Read Job 28:8 and Job 28:23.
c3-job-0018: Job says God understands its way, and the next verse goes on about His work. Read Job 28:26 and Job 28:23.
c3-pro-0020: Wisdom takes her stand on the top of the high hill. Read Proverbs 8:15 and Proverbs 8:2.
c3-ecc-0005: The Preacher sought to find acceptable words. Read Ecclesiastes 12:12 and Ecclesiastes 12:10.
c3-job-0019: Wisdom stands on the high hill, and Job describes a way. Read Job 28:7 and Proverbs 8:2.
c3-pro-0021: Iron is taken from the earth, and wisdom speaks a blessing. Read Proverbs 8:34 and Job 28:2.
c3-ecc-0006: God understands its way, and the Preacher adds a picture of his own. Read Ecclesiastes 12:11 and Job 28:23.
c3-job-0020: God will bring every work to account. Read Job 28:18 and Ecclesiastes 12:14.
c3-pro-0022: The Preacher still taught the people knowledge. Read Proverbs 8:22 and Ecclesiastes 12:9.
c2-pro-0023: Proverbs explains what the sayings help a person understand. Read Proverbs 1:6.
c2-pro-0024: The verse says there are three which are majestic in pace. Read Proverbs 30:1 and Proverbs 30:29.
c3-pro-0025: “Do not rob the poor because he is poor,” Proverbs warns. Read Proverbs 22:20 and Proverbs 22:22.
c3-pro-0026: The LORD will plead the cause of the poor, and the verse warns about an angry man. Read Proverbs 22:25 and Proverbs 22:23.
c3-pro-0027: The verse tells us to judge righteously, and to plead the cause of the poor and needy. Read Proverbs 31:8 and Proverbs 31:9.
c3-pro-0028: Proverbs also names creatures that are majestic in pace. Read Proverbs 30:24 and Proverbs 30:29.
c3-pro-0029: The speaker humbly calls himself more foolish than any man. Read Proverbs 30:28 and Proverbs 30:2.
c3-pro-0030: “To know wisdom and instruction,” the book of Proverbs begins. Read Proverbs 22:21 and Proverbs 1:2.
c3-pro-0031: The verse names honey, and it also warns us not to rob the poor. Read Proverbs 24:13 and Proverbs 22:22.
c3-pro-0032: These are the proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel. Read Proverbs 30:32 and Proverbs 1:1.
c2-hos-0009: Hosea’s book begins with the word of the LORD. Read Hosea 1:1.
c2-jol-0005: Joel’s first verse records the word of the LORD. Read Joel 1:1.
c3-jon-0010: The word of the LORD came at the start of Jonah. Read Jonah 1:1.
c3-nah-0004: This book opens as a vision. Read Nahum 1:1.
c3-zep-0006: The word of the LORD came in the days of Zephaniah. Read Zephaniah 1:1.
c3-oba-0004: Obadiah opens with a vision, and with a report from the LORD. Read Obadiah 1:1.
c3-mic-0010: Micah opens with a call to the peoples. Read Micah 1:2.
c3-hab-0005: Habakkuk describes what happens when the wicked surround the righteous. Read Habakkuk 1:4.
c3-jol-0006: Joel calls the elders and others to hear. Read Joel 1:2.
c3-jol-0010: Joel tells how the report is to be handed down. Read Joel 1:3.
c2-zep-0011: Zephaniah piles up names for that day. Read Zephaniah 1:15.
c2-jol-0007: Joel says, “For strong is the One who executes His word.” Read Joel 2:5 and Joel 2:11.
c3-amo-0010: Amos asks what good the day of the LORD is to you. Read Amos 5:19 and Amos 5:18.
c3-zep-0007: Amos asks, “Is it not very dark, with no brightness in it?” Read Zephaniah 1:16 and Amos 5:20.
c3-jol-0008: Joel again speaks of the One who executes His word. Read Joel 2:7 and Joel 2:11.
c3-amo-0011: Amos speaks to the house of Israel, and Joel speaks of the One who executes His word. Read Amos 5:26 and Joel 2:11.
c3-jol-0009: Amos says the day is very dark, with no brightness in it. Then turn to Joel. Read Joel 2:21 and Amos 5:20.
c3-zep-0010: The prophet says the great day of the LORD is near. Read Zephaniah 1:17 and Zephaniah 1:14.
c3-mal-0005: “You shall eat in plenty and be satisfied,” Joel says. Read Malachi 4:3 and Joel 2:26.
c3-amo-0012: Joel speaks of the One who executes His word, and Amos speaks of captivity. Read Amos 5:27 and Joel 2:11.
c2-isa-0028: Isaiah speaks of righteousness in that day. Read Isaiah 11:5.
c2-isa-0029: “The remnant will return, the remnant of Jacob,” Isaiah says. Read Isaiah 10:20 and Isaiah 10:21.
c3-mic-0011: “Your hand shall be lifted against your adversaries,” Micah says. Read Micah 5:11 and Micah 5:9.
c3-zep-0008: The LORD says He will save the lame. Read Zephaniah 3:18 and Zephaniah 3:19.
c3-zec-0009: Zechariah tells the people the things they shall do. Read Zechariah 8:10 and Zechariah 8:16.
c3-isa-0030: Isaiah speaks of a highway for the remnant. Read Isaiah 11:11 and Isaiah 11:16.
c3-mic-0012: “I will surely assemble all of you, O Jacob,” says the LORD. Read Micah 2:13 and Micah 2:12.
c3-zep-0009: “I will leave in your midst A meek and humble people,” says the LORD. Read Zephaniah 3:20 and Zephaniah 3:12.
c3-zec-0010: The verse names the things you shall do. It also speaks of the city. Read Zechariah 8:5 and Zechariah 8:16.
c3-isa-0031: Isaiah says a remnant of them will return. Read Isaiah 11:15 and Isaiah 10:22.
c2-1ki-0019: The people of Israel were divided into two parts. Read First Kings 16:21.
c2-1ki-0020: The verse names Elah the son of Baasha. Omri bought a place from Shemer. Read First Kings 16:24 and First Kings 16:8.
c3-1ki-0021: The verse names Zimri’s strike against Elah. Then Omri becomes king over Israel. Read First Kings 16:23 and First Kings 16:10.
c3-2ki-0021: The verse names Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz, and later Shallum the son of Jabesh. Read Second Kings 15:13 and Second Kings 13:10.
c3-2ki-0022: A man went up from Tirzah to Samaria. Read Second Kings 15:23 and Second Kings 15:14.
c3-2ki-0023: The LORD delivered Israel into the hand of Hazael king of Syria. Read Second Kings 15:27 and Second Kings 13:3.
c3-2ki-0024: The verse names Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz. Then the LORD struck the king. Read Second Kings 15:5 and Second Kings 13:10.
c3-2ch-0007: Uzziah sought God while Zechariah lived, and he built in Jerusalem. Read Second Chronicles 26:9 and Second Chronicles 26:5.
c3-2ch-0008: Jotham built in the mountains of Judah. Devices were also made in Jerusalem. Read Second Chronicles 26:15 and Second Chronicles 27:4.
c3-2ch-0009: The verse tells when Jotham became king. Read Second Chronicles 27:6 and Second Chronicles 27:8.
c2-ezr-0008: The articles were brought out by Cyrus’s command. Read Ezra 1:8.
c2-neh-0009: The verse names the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes. Read Nehemiah 1:1 and Nehemiah 2:1.
c3-neh-0010: The king asked, “How long will your journey be?” Read Nehemiah 2:8 and Nehemiah 2:6.
c3-est-0008: Mordecai was well received by many of his people. The verse also names King Ahasuerus. Read Esther 1:1 and Esther 10:3.
c3-est-0009: Mordecai found favor with many of his people. The lot was also cast before Haman. Read Esther 3:7 and Esther 10:3.
c3-est-0010: Mordecai wrote these things and sent letters to all the Jews. Read Esther 9:31 and Esther 9:20.
c3-hag-0005: Those around them encouraged the people who were going. Read Haggai 1:1 and Ezra 1:6.
c3-zec-0011: The word of the LORD came, and Ezra begins the count of the articles. Read Zechariah 1:1 and Ezra 1:9.
c3-zec-0012: Malachi names what came to Israel, and Zechariah asks a question. Read Zechariah 1:5 and Malachi 1:1.
c3-ezr-0009: The men of a person’s place should help him, and the verse also counts the articles. Read Ezra 1:11 and Ezra 1:4.
